observed_condition: Imported pointers and retained structured associations have identifiable targets but do not supply the same evidence as a final SKB coverage-scope statement.
proposed_record_fields: Relation origin; direction; source field; source and target identifiers; assessment stage; covered aspects; residual aspects; decision authority and date.
automatable_check: Require each claimed coverage relation to have a typed target, source locator and explicit origin; flag a coverage label without a corresponding scope/adoption statement.
technical_judgment: Whether the specified targets jointly address the stated aspects and what remains outside that coverage.
claim_limit: A software check can test required fields and references, not prove physical completeness.
secondary_analysis_risk: Conflating an imported statement, a selection field and an adopted coverage decision.
proposed_responsible_role: Safety-case owner and responsible technical assessor
review_trigger: New or substantively revised coverage decision; adoption of an imported relation
followup_record: Adoption authority and date; stated target set and joint scope; residual aspects and their disposition.

scope: Primary documentary record and identifier resolution
observed_condition: Mechanical stresses has different target identifiers in different components; Bu13 is resolved using its stated process/component namespace.
proposed_record_fields: Target object type; assessment version; system component; literal identifier; literal name; ambiguity status.
automatable_check: Resolve by identifier or by the composite of object type, version, component and name; reject multiple matches instead of choosing the first.
technical_judgment: Whether the resolved component is the intended subject of the screening decision.
claim_limit: Unique name resolution establishes a documentary association, not scope equivalence.
secondary_analysis_risk: A name-only join can select VarC05 instead of the source-qualified VarF05.
proposed_responsible_role: Database custodian with the responsible technical assessor
review_trigger: Inventory import; target renaming or catalogue/version update
followup_record: Resolved composite identifier or explicit ambiguity; reconciliation action, authority and remaining question.

observed_condition: A final excluded status coexists with retained handling rows; an SR-Can provisional pointer has no stated SR-Site successor.
proposed_record_fields: Relation validity stage; retained-as-history flag; superseding or successor identifier; disposition rationale; event date separate from database revision date.
automatable_check: Flag stage mismatches and associations attached to excluded sources unless their historical retention or current disposition is explicitly recorded.
technical_judgment: Whether an association should be retired, retained for history, or migrated to another assessed object.
claim_limit: A retained record is not evidence of active use or of a current PSAR database state.
secondary_analysis_risk: Treating valid historical identifiers as current-stage treatment endpoints.
review_trigger: Screening-status revision; database release or assessment-stage transition
followup_record: Retained, superseded, retired or unresolved disposition; applicable stage, reason and successor where identified.

observed_condition: An association can contain a non-handling reason or a qualifier about its fit to the source description.
proposed_record_fields: Handled aspects; unhandled aspects and reason; residual scope; relation-level qualifications.
automatable_check: Preserve handled and unhandled fields separately; expose populated non-handling reasons and fit qualifications whenever a path is displayed.
technical_judgment: Whether the non-handling rationale is adequate for the stated context.
claim_limit: Neither relevant source status nor the presence of an edge is sufficient to label a process affirmatively modelled.
secondary_analysis_risk: Collapsing handled, unhandled and qualified associations into the same graph edge label.
proposed_responsible_role: Pathway export maintainer and responsible technical assessor
review_trigger: Pathway export; revision of a handling annotation or supporting assessment
followup_record: Source-located handled and unhandled statements; qualifications preserved in the exported path; any unresolved interpretation.

observed_condition: Applicability reasons can concern a waste form, site condition or residual material route, while a described physical process can have a wider scope.
proposed_record_fields: Excluded aspect; site/design/waste assumption; supporting location; process relevance outside that assumption; disposition of residual possibilities.
automatable_check: Require an applicability reason to identify its bounded condition and support; flag residual possibilities raised in notes without a recorded disposition.
technical_judgment: Whether the applicability assumption justifies the exclusion and whether a residual route requires separate treatment.
claim_limit: A missing residual disposition is a documentary question, not evidence that the material or hazard exists.
secondary_analysis_risk: Treating every applicability exclusion as a missing coverage link or converting a reviewer-proposed link into an SKB decision.
proposed_responsible_role: Safety-case owner and responsible waste, design or site technical area
review_trigger: Change to the waste inventory, repository design or site premise linked to an exclusion
followup_record: Specification version and affected premise; retained, revised or referred decision; excluded aspect and residual-scope disposition.

observed_condition: N 1.1 has no eligible candidate under the shared-IFEP gate; N 1.3.4 has an eligible top candidate below the cutoff and empty source text.
proposed_record_fields: Eligibility count and exclusion reason; source-field availability; component scores; weighting specification; threshold; margin; search-lead status.
automatable_check: Distinguish no eligible pool from below-threshold ranking; report source-text zeros and the exact score decomposition alongside every retained or rejected lead.
technical_judgment: Whether a candidate warrants source review and whether its scope is substantively comparable.
claim_limit: Thresholds govern retrieval output; they do not measure the probability of equivalent or complete coverage.
secondary_analysis_risk: Interpreting non-recovery as physical omission or inventory differences as substantive risk after ignoring metadata and score constraints.
review_trigger: Use of counterpart search in review; change to eligibility, representation, weights or cutoff
followup_record: Versioned search configuration and outcome class; source-text stratum and benchmark limits; any later assessor decision recorded separately.
